A '''space battle''' which took place at a deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] rendezvous point late in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] was an important battle of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and the [[Confederation]], the [[Five Worlds]] government of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] conspired to kill Alliance [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]. Acting without Confederate support, [[Five World Prime Minister]] [[Sadras Koyan]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Minister of Information (Five Worlds)|Minister of Information]] [[Denjax Teppler]] worked to render [[Centerpoint Station]], an ancient [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] that hung in the Corellian [[Star system/Legends|system]], reactivated and operational. As [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] worked on the station, Koyan contacted the Alliance and requested a meeting with Solo at a deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] rendezvous point, where a supposed defection of Corellia from the Confederation to the Alliance could be discussed.

==The battle==
Solo arrived at rendezvous point in his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']], accompanied by elements of the [[Second Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Second Fleet]]. There, he met a Corellian [[Decoy fleet]] composed of decommissioned and nearly derelict [[Starship/Legends|vessels]]. Before negotiations began, he was contacted by his [[Parent/Legends|mother]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], onboard the [[Luxury 2400 yacht|SoroSuub 2400 yacht]] ''[[Love Commander]]''. The [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] docked in one of the ''Anakin Solo''{{'s}} [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bays, and Organa Solo joined her son on the bridge to give him a stern talking-to. Meanwhile, her [[Han Solo/Legends|husband]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|daughter]], and [[Jagged Fel|two]] [[Zekk|friends]], who were hidden aboard the yacht, infiltrated the ship to commit sabotage. When they returned, they briefly did battle with the [[Force phantom]] of the renegade [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alema Rar]].

Solo began to negotiate with Corellian [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hoclaw]] via [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]]. When he realized that his mother was gone, he suspected she had planted a bomb somewhere, and he boarded a [[TIE Reconnaissance Fighter]] with his daughter [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]] and left the vessel. The [[Jedi Coalition]]'s [[Red Sword Flight]], who were working in tandem with the crew of the ''Love Commander'', arrived on scene in [[StealthX]]s and began to battle him. They held off making kill shots when they [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] a child's presence in his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].

Corellian reinforcements arrived and a battle began. The Decoy fleet took a beating from the Alliance Second Fleet, but, anticipating an attack from Centerpoint Station, kept their distance. Koyan, Teppler, and Corellian [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Genna Delpin]] were concurrently aboard Centerpoint with a group of technicians and authorized them to fire. The [[Space station/Legends|station's]] [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] weapon destroyed the Decoy Fleet and much of the Second Fleet, but the Chief of State and the ''Anakin Solo'' escaped.

==Aftermath==
[[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]], the [[Supreme Commander of the Confederation military]], was angered that Corellia had acted alone, and cut the planet off from all Confederation aid. When Teppler privately appealed to him, he affirmed that Corellia would only be welcomed back in to the Confederate fold if Koyan were removed from power. The Alliance became aware that Centerpoint was operational and later launched an [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|attack]] on it; during the attack, Teppler maneuvered Koyan to his death in order to secure Confederate reinforcements.
